If you use them more than two weeks after roasting, most of the nuance of the flavor is gone due to changes in the chemical composition of the beans.

r:

3. Go on long walks or runs outside
4. Intermittent fast for 16 hours a day
5. Drink more water
6. Drink less alcohol
